title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "version": "schemaxis.freecad/1",
  "declarations": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.adaptor:DECLARATIONS",
  "runtimeFamily": "1.1.x",
  "executables": [
    "freecadcmd"
  ],
  "execution": "isolated CAD processes; verified FCStd, STEP and tessellated STL in mm",
  "keywords": [
    "CAD",
    "parametric solids",
    "STEP",
    "boolean",
    "meshes",
    "mould-release draft",
    "draft angle",
    "moulded enclosure",
    "native spreadsheet",
    "engineering table",
    "spreadsheet aliases",
    "mixed-unit dimensions",
    "STL to solid",
    "mesh preparation",
    "faceted BREP",
    "Draft polygon",
    "editable outline",
    "Draft Wire"
  ],
  "id": "freecad",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.adaptor",
  "executionCapabilities": {
    "modes": [
      "process"
    ],
    "mpi": false
  },
  "consoleCapabilities": {
    "authoredSessions": true,
    "multipleDocuments": true,
    "liveGeometry": true,
    "visualReferences": true,
    "geometryReferences": true,
    "imagePixelReferences": true,
    "imageReferenceRequirement": "a current native PNG preview; no inferred object identity",
    "nativeEditReverseSync": false
  },
  "consoleTemplate": {
    "version": "schemaxis.freecad/1",
    "nodes": [],
    "output": null,
    "units": "mm",
    "linearDeflection": 0.1
  },
  "consoleOutput": true,
  "defaultConsole": true,
  "environment": "FREECAD_CMD",
  "nativeExtension": ".fcstd",
  "consoleHooks": {
    "live_location": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:live_location",
    "validate": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:validate",
    "add": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:add",
    "show": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:show",
    "live_save": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:live_save",
    "model": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:model",
    "command": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.console:command"
  },
  "cliOptions": [
    {
      "flag": "--freecad",
      "dest": "freecad",
      "help": "Explicit freecad executable"
    },
    {
      "flag": "--freecad-gui",
      "dest": "freecad_gui",
      "help": "Optional FreeCAD GUI launcher"
    }
  ],
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis.freecad/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.adaptor",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "graph": false,
      "timeBatches": false,
      "schemaName": "freecad",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cad"
      ],
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.adaptor:schema",
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.integration:resources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.integration:reusableInputs",
        "retainedInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.integration:retainedInputs",
        "expandedSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.integration:expandedSchema",
        "inspect": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.integration:inspect",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.captured_inputs:accept_resource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.captured_inputs:captured_schema"
      },
      "expand": "composition",
      "schemaOrder": 2
    },
    "schemaxis.freecad.assembly/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.assembly",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "assembly",
      "referenceName": "freecad-assembly",
      "expand": "composition",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cadScene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.assembly:reusableInputs",
        "retainedInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.assembly:retainedInputs"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.assembly:schema",
      "runOptions": {
        "gui_executable": "freecad_gui"
      },
      "queryFlags": {
        "fixedAssemblies": true
      },
      "querySchema": "docs/generated/freecad-assembly.schema.json",
      "queryReference": "docs/freecad-assemblies.md",
      "schemaOrder": 3
    },
    "schemaxis.freecad.drawing/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "drawing",
      "referenceName": "freecad-drawing",
      "expand": "composition",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cad",
        "cadScene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing:reusableInputs",
        "retainedInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing:retainedInputs",
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing:resources"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing:schema",
      "runOptions": {
        "gui_executable": "freecad_gui"
      },
      "queryFlags": {
        "technicalDrawings": true
      },
      "querySchema": "docs/generated/freecad-drawing.schema.json",
      "queryReference": "docs/freecad-drawings.md",
      "schemaOrder": 4
    },
    "schemaxis.freecad.analysis/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "freecad-analysis",
      "referenceName": "freecad-analysis",
      "expand": "composition",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cad",
        "cadScene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis:resources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis:reusableInputs",
        "retainedInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis:retainedInputs"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis:schema",
      "schemaOrder": 5
    },
    "schemaxis.freecad.mechanism/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.mechanism",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "mechanism",
      "referenceName": "freecad-mechanism",
      "expand": "composition",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cadScene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.mechanism:resources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.mechanism:reusableInputs"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.mechanism:schema",
      "runOptions": {
        "gui_executable": "freecad_gui"
      },
      "queryFlags": {
        "prescribedMechanisms": true
      },
      "querySchema": "docs/generated/freecad-mechanism.schema.json",
      "queryReference": "docs/freecad-mechanisms.md",
      "schemaOrder": 7
    },
    "schemaxis.freecad.cam/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "cam",
      "referenceName": "freecad-cam",
      "expand": "composition",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "cad",
        "cadScene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam:reusableInputs",
        "retainedInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam:retainedInputs",
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam:resources"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam:schema",
      "queryFlags": {
        "milling": true
      },
      "querySchema": "docs/generated/freecad-cam.schema.json",
      "queryReference": "docs/freecad-cam.md",
      "schemaOrder": 6
    }
  },
  "sections": {
    "assembly": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.assembly:schema",
    "drawing": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.drawing:schema",
    "freecad-analysis": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.analysis:schema",
    "mechanism": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.mechanism:schema",
    "cam": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.cam:schema"
  },
  "referenceIntro": [
    "All routes support shared document/value expressions and finite analytic studies through the framework runtime.",
    "Lengths use millimetres. All outputs must be one valid positive-volume solid.",
    "See [CAD and mesh workflows](../cad-and-mesh-workflows.md) for native and tessellated output limits.",
    "Mould-release bodyDraft retains selected planar/cylindrical faces, neutral profile plane and optional pull axis; see [Draft feature workflows](../freecad-draft.md).",
    "Native spreadsheet inputs and affine formula aliases drive editable part dimensions; see [engineering tables](../freecad-spreadsheets.md).",
    "Checked importMesh makes a faceted Part solid from closed STL with explicit units, winding and frame; see [Mesh preparation](../freecad-mesh-preparation.md).",
    "Editable straight-edged Draft profiles compose Part extrusions and booleans; see [polygon profiles](../freecad-draft-profiles.md)."
  ],
  "consoleCommands": [
    "box ID LENGTH WIDTH HEIGHT",
    "rectangle ID WIDTH HEIGHT",
    "circle ID RADIUS",
    "extrude ID [PROFILE] LENGTH"
  ],
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.freecad.capabilities:catalogue"
}
